scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @kalitiri/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build:core && node --test packages/game-core/test/*.test.mjs apps/colyseus-server/test/*.test.mjs
